visuals.name: Kraken
visuals.kind: Official publisher textured model promotional render
visuals.identity: Official Block Factory trailer is titled Bosses Rise KRAKEN UPDATE, its description links the mod and publisher website. Native red and cream Kraken model with yellow eyes and suckered tentacles visible.
visuals.transform: Crop only from 1280 by 720 original, rectangle [560,70,1280,720], producing 720 by 650. Excludes the contextual player. Peripheral tentacles are clipped, core face and body preserved. No retouching or watermark removal.
visuals.inspection: Single recognizable Kraken face and body fill the image. No text or watermark. Stylized publisher thumbnail, not an in-game screenshot. Crop does not imply full-body view.

visuals.name: Sandworm
visuals.kind: Single publisher textured model view cropped from original montage
visuals.identity: Previously verified official description embed. Original montage depicts this creature alongside matching gameplay. Crop retains only the large right-hand worm model with toothed mouth and segmented body.
visuals.transform: Crop only from native 1634 by 577 original, rectangle [804,10,1534,567], producing 730 by 557. No enlargement or retouching. The single model remains on its original mixed black and sandy background; thin pink decorative lines remain.
visuals.inspection: One large worm depiction, not multiple creature panels. Teeth, mouth, ridged body and underside are readily identifiable. No blocking text or watermark. Decorative background lines remain; not a newly rendered game screenshot.
